Paragraph: Just try to learn the truth by approaching a spiritual master. Inquire from him submissively and render service unto him. The self-realized soul can impart knowledge unto you because he has seen the truth.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Struggling with self-doubt, arrogance, or ineffective solo speculation on complex life truths.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna states: 'Just try to learn the truth by approaching a spiritual master. Inquire from him submissively and render service unto him. The self-realized soul can impart knowledge unto you because he has seen the truth.'
Outcome/Resolution: Receiving guidance through submissive inquiry and dedicated service unlocks genuine, transformative knowledge.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Mentorship and Guidance: Seeking wisdom from experienced teachers to navigate complex psychological challenges
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Humility in Learning: Setting aside ego to receive constructive insights
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Receptivity to Truth: Combining respectful questioning with practical service to absorb wisdom

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Tad viddhi pranipatena (Learn the truth by humble surrender)
Jnani-nas tattva-darsinah (Self-realized seers of the Ultimate Truth)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Approaching a realized master with surrender, inquiry, and service opens the door to receiving divine truth.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Growth requires overcoming intellectual ego; structured mentorship paired with humble inquiry accelerates self-mastery.
